Over the life of a shoe, the cushioning eventually becomes compressed, reducing its effectiveness. This is the “worn out” feeling that means it’s time for a new pair. Infinion foam is designed to make more runs feel like your first run. ### Enhanced cushioning and energy return Resiliency is just one part of what makes Infinion foam a gamechanger. The enhanced cushioning and energy return are a new standard for what a high-mileage daily routine can feel like. Your routine may be regular, but the 1080v15 is anything but. ### New look, breathable materials The midsole isn’t all that’s new. The 1080v15 looks as different as it feels, with an updated design featuring a contoured, perforated mesh upper. Reinterpreting the shoe's performance capabilities with updated materials and componentry, this version became the first iteration in the sneaker's lineage to be designed by someone other than Toshikazu Kayano. products.description: ## Road and track racing shoe - Carbon fiber - All-Gender ### Colour: DK DENIM /SLPHR SPRG/SCLT IBIS  Can’t decide on the right size for you? Gara Carbon is the ultimate race-day tool , combining unparalleled responsiveness, stability, and comfort.  We’ve taken it further. Meet Gara Carbon 3 : a lighter, faster evolution built for unmatched energy return.  Just like the previous versions, Gara Carbon 3 is powered by a carbon plate developed to create an extreme shape with a maximum curvature : high on the hill height, low on the forefoot and high toe spring. Embedded in the midsole, a full-length carbon fiber plate in thermoset resin enhances rigidity, ensuring no energy is wasted as it propels you forward.  Engineered with ANIMA PBX , this compound elevates midsole rebound by an impressive 55% while cutting weight by 40% compared to EVA Light. See our size guide or find out about our easy return policy  The right pieces make all the difference in the long run. The latest addition to the Diadora Race Pack offers maximum support for track races from 800 to 10,000 meters .  Energy return, fast transitions, and explosive propulsion. The core of Mezzofondo is the Anima PBX compound , a high-performance foam midsole capable of maximising energy return during the thrust phase. This foam combined with an exclusive full-length carbon fibre spike plate will maximise your performance. See our size guide or find out about our easy return policy   Delivery is generally made within 3 to 5 working days from when the order is accepted   The right pieces make all the difference in the long run. That’s why we developed Diadora FIBRAZERO yarns: total thermoregulation control , long-lasting anti-odour properties and consistent performance , session after session.  We’ve updated the Warm Up Winter Protection running fleece to make it even more performance-driven . Its 3D waffle inner structure creates a self-regulating thermal environment without compromising breathability. The construction is key, carefully engineered to reduce friction zones and support smooth movement.  We’ve also integrated only the essential details: thumbhole cuffs, a smartwatch window in warm interlock fabric, an outer collar lined with windproof material — a detail also featured on the two front zip pockets. Inside the right pocket, a small mesh key pocket adds extra functionality. For night sessions, a reflective tape enhances visibility .  Breathable and warm at the same time, FIBRAZERO post-consumer coffee yarns help moisture dry quickly so you can focus on what matters.  Men's technical fleece with pockets and reflective details  Updated for even better performance. A tool designed for the perfect movement, meticulously studied in our CRD to allow the athletic gesture in its maximum expression. Discover Lungo Carbon, the result of the constant dialogue between Diadora and its athletes.   How to enhance a technical gesture, an athletic movement - how to support it? Every athlete's tool has this difficult and rigorous task: supporting a human being in the realization of a perfect gesture, precise to the last millimeter. This is what Lungo Carbon has been conceived for.  Lungo Carbon is a long jump spike shoe that combines a full-length carbon plate with an Anima PBX midsole. While the carbon plate assures the required torsional and longitudinal stiffness, the Anima PBX compound was designed to achieve superior springback. It supports the long jumper during the run-up to reach maximum controllable speed for the perfect takeoff, and provides stability and comfort during the landing.  While maintaining the rigidity features typical of long jump spike shoes, Lungo Carbon has been designed to facilitate forefoot thrust. The ergonomic shape of the sole, which is rounded at the front, has been designed to facilitate dynamic running, with  particular focus on the roll at take-off for the best flight angle in the jump phase. The Matryx mesh upper is enriched by carbon fibre on the medial part of the foot and this, together with the velcro fastening, guarantees a perfect fitting and the maximum stability.  Lungo Carbon is an important link between our advanced technologies, our commitment for technological development in sport and our dedication to allowing our athletes to reach the highest levels in their performance.  Cushioning, responsiveness and lightness. See our size guide or find out about our easy return policy  A meticulous, inspired research  Introducing Lungo Carbon - a competition tool that embodies the performance DNA of Diadora, combining maximum responsiveness, stability and a full-length carbon plate.  A tool designed for the perfect movement, meticulously studied in our CRD to allow the athletic gesture in its maximum expression. Discover Lungo Carbon, the result of the constant dialogue between Diadora and its athletes.   How to enhance a technical gesture, an athletic movement - how to support it? Every athlete's tool has this difficult and rigorous task: supporting a human being in the realization of a perfect gesture, precise to the last millimeter. This is what Lungo Carbon has been conceived for.  Lungo Carbon is a long jump spike shoe that combines a full-length carbon plate with an Anima PBX midsole. While the carbon plate assures the required torsional and longitudinal stiffness, the Anima PBX compound was designed to achieve superior springback. It supports the long jumper during the run-up to reach maximum controllable speed for the perfect takeoff, and provides stability and comfort during the landing.  While maintaining the rigidity features typical of long jump spike shoes, Lungo Carbon has been designed to facilitate forefoot thrust. The ergonomic shape of the sole, which is rounded at the front, has been designed to facilitate dynamic running, with  particular focus on the roll at take-off for the best flight angle in the jump phase. The Matryx mesh upper is enriched by carbon fibre on the medial part of the foot and this, together with the velcro fastening, guarantees a perfect fitting and the maximum stability.  Lungo Carbon is an important link between our advanced technologies, our commitment for technological development in sport and our dedication to allowing our athletes to reach the highest levels in their performance.  Cushioning, responsiveness and lightness. Anima PBX is the new Diadora technology in PEBAX SCF (Super Critical Foaming) that increases midsole rebound by 55%, while reducing its weight by 40%  With carbon fibres to lighten the shoe  Nylon + 6-mm studs; light EVA in heel area   230 gr / 8,1 oz (+/- 3%) - size 7,5 USW   The new ANIMA PBX technology, created using super critical foaming, stands out for its extreme lightness and responsiveness, as well as its elevated cushioning. A special compound capable of increasing the responsiveness of the midsole by 55% while reducing its weight by 40%. Discover Lungo Carbon, the result of the constant dialogue between Diadora and its athletes.   How to enhance a technical gesture, an athletic movement - how to support it? Every athlete's tool has this difficult and rigorous task: supporting a human being in the realization of a perfect gesture, precise to the last millimeter. This is what Lungo Carbon has been conceived for.  Lungo Carbon is a long jump spike shoe that combines a full-length carbon plate with an Anima PBX midsole. While the carbon plate assures the required torsional and longitudinal stiffness, the Anima PBX compound was designed to achieve superior springback. It supports the long jumper during the run-up to reach maximum controllable speed for the perfect takeoff, and provides stability and comfort during the landing. The ergonomic shape of the sole, which is rounded at the front, has been designed to facilitate dynamic running, with  particular focus on the roll at take-off for the best flight angle in the jump phase. The Matryx mesh upper is enriched by carbon fibre on the medial part of the foot and this, together with the velcro fastening, guarantees a perfect fitting and the maximum stability. Discover Lungo Carbon, the result of the constant dialogue between Diadora and its athletes.   How to enhance a technical gesture, an athletic movement - how to support it? Every athlete's tool has this difficult and rigorous task: supporting a human being in the realization of a perfect gesture, precise to the last millimeter. This is what Lungo Carbon has been conceived for.  Lungo Carbon is a long jump spike shoe that combines a full-length carbon plate with an Anima PBX midsole. While the carbon plate assures the required torsional and longitudinal stiffness, the Anima PBX compound was designed to achieve superior springback. It supports the long jumper during the run-up to reach maximum controllable speed for the perfect takeoff, and provides stability and comfort during the landing.  While maintaining the rigidity features typical of long jump spike shoes, Lungo Carbon has been designed to facilitate forefoot thrust. The ergonomic shape of the sole, which is rounded at the front, has been designed to facilitate dynamic running, with  particular focus on the roll at take-off for the best flight angle in the jump phase. The Matryx mesh upper is enriched by carbon fibre on the medial part of the foot and this, together with the velcro fastening, guarantees a perfect fitting and the maximum stability.  Lungo Carbon is an important link between our advanced technologies, our commitment for technological development in sport and our dedication to allowing our athletes to reach the highest levels in their performance.  Cushioning, responsiveness and lightness. Anima PBX is the new Diadora technology in PEBAX SCF (Super Critical Foaming) that increases midsole rebound by 55%, while reducing its weight by 40%  With carbon fibres to lighten the shoe  Nylon + 6-mm studs; light EVA in heel area   230 gr / 8,1 oz (+/- 3%) - size 7,5 USW   The new ANIMA PBX technology, created using super critical foaming, stands out for its extreme lightness and responsiveness, as well as its elevated cushioning. A special compound capable of increasing the responsiveness of the midsole by 55% while reducing its weight by 40%.  Shoe developed on a last which refl ects the ergonomics of the female foot. products.description: ## Road and track racing shoe - Carbon fiber - All-Gender ### Colour: WHITE/BLACK/KUMQUAT  Can’t decide on the right size for you? See our size guide or find out about our easy return policy  Fits true to size , take your normal size.    Delivery is generally made within 3 to 5 working days from when the order is accepted   Gara Carbon: our diamond, the spearhead enhancing the performance soul of the brand. A racing tool combining extreme rebound, stability and comfort. Giving off a sense of energy.  A way to master energy, to enhance and celebrate it. Gara Carbon represents the ultimate racing tool. It's a way to learn how to use energy in the best way possible - to break records, to reach the maximum speed, to push limits. Dive deep in the process: feel the feet hitting the ground, feel the energy return pushing the body forward, on and on. Feel the propulsion, the heart pumping blood through the veins, the body gaining speed.  Gara Carbon is powered by a carbon plate developed to create an extreme shape with a maximum curvature: high on the hill height, low on the forefoot and high toe spring. The plate is full-length, 100% carbon - the noblest and most performing solution when talking about sole rigidity. Gara Carbon is also the first shoe developed with Anima PBX. This compound is capable of improving midsole rebound of 55% while reducing 40% of the weight. This 230g shoe has an unmatched propulsion and a total rebound of 80% lab tested. Upper in Matrix Mesh with carbon yarns to enhance the lightness. Above the midsole, this carbon fiber plate embedded in thermosetting resin extends throughout the length of the footwear, stiffening the sole to prevent the energy discharged by the athlete from dissipating to the ground.  Gara Carbon is the way to bring performance to a new level for runners looking for a racing shoe that combines lightness, stability and comfort with superior reactivity. It's the tool to break records on road and train for the maximum speed on track.   Extreme curvature, developed to provide maximum thrust and propulsion  Beat your records and reach maximum speed thanks to the carbon plate and Anima PBX technology  Cushioning, responsiveness and lightness. Anima PBX is the new Diadora technology in PEBAX SCF (Super Critical Foaming) that increases midsole rebound by 55%, while reducing its weight by 40%  Laboratory tests show a total rebound of 80%  Mesh Matrix upper with carbon fibres to lighten the shoe   EVA sheared and micro-perforated   Special Duratech 5000 wear-resistant compound across the entire foot area   230 gr (8.11 oz) +/- 3% - size 9 UK   A carbon plate is positioned above the midsole embedded in thermosetting resin that extends along the entire length of the shoe. The main function of this plate is to reinforce the sole so that the energy discharged to the ground by the runner is not dispersed. Combined with the Anima PBX technology, it ensures an energy return of 85%, which is one of the highest standards on the market.
